subject: english
question:
**Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the underlined words in the following sentence.**

This was a __blatent disregard __to the __advisory __by the host against it and in __violation __of norms of the meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is '**blatent**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word in the sentence is: **blatent**.
 
• **blatent** (Incorrectly spelled, the correct spelling is "**blatant**.")
 
• Meanings of the words:
 
 
• **advisory** (सलाहकार) - having the function of giving advice or recommendations.
 
• **blatant** (खुली बात) - (of bad behavior) done openly and unashamedly; completely lacking in subtlety.
 
• **disregard** (उपेक्षा) - the action or state of ignoring or paying no attention to something.
 
• **violation** (उल्लंघन) - the action of violating someone or something. 
 
 
 
• ***Corrected sentence:**__* *This was a blatant disregard to the advisory by the host against it and in violation of norms of the meeting.*
 
 
• *Example sentence using "**blatant**": His blatant disregard for the rules of the game resulted in his disqualification.*
